genuinely_worse.definition: BC-final's exact 14-digit card accuracy on the same audit cards is at least 3 percentage points below v2's (delta_star = 0.03, about 11 more people of 377 given a wrong reading)
genuinely_worse.why_3_points: it is smaller than BC-final's own measured advantage on the controls (+7 net of 168 = +4.2 points), so a model this far below v2 would erase more than the gain that justified choosing it

criterion_4_candidates.scaled_cap: fail when regressed_exact > c, for c in 3..12
criterion_4_candidates.non_inferiority: one-sided score test (constrained maximum likelihood, the Tango form) of H0: acc_BC - acc_v2 <= -delta_ni on the same cards, all audit cards with a valid label (an admission failure is both-wrong and therefore concordant), alpha one-sided 0.05; criterion 4 passes when H0 is rejected; delta_ni in {0.02, 0.03, 0.04, 0.05}
criterion_4_candidates.size_guard: if the instrument-validator finds the score test's actual size at the H0 boundary above 0.055 at the audit's shape, the test's critical value is replaced by a simulation-calibrated one, declared here in advance

scenarios.per_card_cells_source: the 168 internal controls, published in 2M-H: both right 151, BC only right 8, v2 only right 1, both wrong 8. They have been read as a gate 13 times and BC-final was chosen on the spent external validation, so the controls advantage is if anything optimistic; this is stated wherever the numbers appear.
scenarios.admission_failure: 0.10 (the rehearsal's 2 of 20 on development calibration cards), with 0.0 and 0.20 as sensitivity. An admission failure is both-wrong for criterion 4 and absent from criterion 1.
scenarios.typo_coincidence: the per-card probability that an admitted BC-final error is silently accepted with a structurally valid typo, estimated by applying the frozen typo generator (seed-varied, 20,000 draws per error) to the 9 control errors, in process, printing no identifier
scenarios.S1_plug_in: cells fixed at the control proportions
scenarios.S2_predictive: cells redrawn per simulated audit from Dirichlet(counts + 0.5), which carries the controls' own uncertainty
scenarios.S3_equal: BC-final exactly as accurate as v2: BC-only and v2-only cells 4.5/168 each, both wrong 8/168. Reported, not a selection constraint.
scenarios.S4_worse: v2 as on the controls; BC-final accuracy lower by delta. Two discordance variants, low churn (BC-only 1/168) and high churn (BC-only 8/168); power is the minimum of the two

computation.simulation: 200,000 simulated audits of 377 cards per scenario and candidate, fixed seed 20260923, joint over criteria 1, 2 and 4, Monte Carlo standard error reported
computation.overall_false_fail: P(criterion 1 or 2 or 4 fails) under S1 (at each admission value) and S2
computation.power: P(criterion 4 fails) under S4 at each delta, minimum over the two variants
computation.old_criteria_side_by_side: the same simulation for the old four criteria (with 7b B1 and 7 correction A), so the old and new false-fail are shown next to each other
computation.validation_before_use: the instrument-validator checks the calculator on synthetic ground truth (analytic binomial and Poisson tails for single criteria, the score test's size at its boundary) and order preservation (false-fail non-increasing in c, power non-decreasing in delta) before any number decides

selection_rule.eligible: overall false-fail <= 0.05 under S1 at every admission value AND under S2, AND criterion-4 power >= 0.80 at delta_star = 0.03
selection_rule.choose: the eligible candidate with the highest power at delta_star; ties go to the lower S2 false-fail, then to non-inferiority over a cap because it judges the net effect
selection_rule.if_none_eligible: STOP. Nothing is chosen. The owner is shown the trade-off table and decides.

near_misses.ni_0.04: S2 false-fail 0.0463, but power at 3 points 0.797 < 0.80

false_fail_side_by_side.unit: probability that the audit fails when BC-final performs as on the controls; 200,000 simulated audits of 377 cards, seed 20260923, Monte Carlo SE about 0.0005 near 0.05

power_of_criterion_4_to_catch_a_worse_mo.definition: P(criterion 4 fails) when BC-final's accuracy over all audit cards is lower than v2's by delta; minimum over low and high churn

stated_plainly: S2 at 0.0494 is about 1.2 Monte Carlo standard errors under 0.05. The choice holds at the declared seed and simulation count; nothing was re-run to move it.

Criterion 1 alone contributes about 0.045 under S2. S2 averages over true error rates the controls cannot exclude, including rates above 0.10 where failing is correct, so S2 overstates the chance of a false fail. No criterion-4 design can take S2 below about 0.045, because criterion 1 is unchanged by the owner's decision.

If BC-final is only as good as v2 (S3), the audit fails about 21 percent of the time. That is the price of catching a model 3 points worse 95 percent of the time. A fail on criterion 4 therefore means 'non-inferiority at 3 points not shown', not 'worse'; 'worse' is said only under D-003.

The scenario inputs are the 168 controls, read as a gate 13 times, with BC-final chosen on a spent set. If its real advantage over v2 is smaller than on the controls, the true false-fail lies between S1 and S3.

There is roughly a 1-in-10 chance that the exact (infinite-simulation) value lies above 0.05, in which case the declared rule would have stopped. The decision stands on the declared computation.

C_the_fused_numbers_are_descriptive.rule: every fused-system quantity (configs/phase4_integration_rule_v1.json step_5_audit.fused_descriptive_quantities) is reported and never enters a criterion or the token
C_the_fused_numbers_are_descriptive.label: POSSIBLY CONTAMINATED: the contributed model's training data are unverified, and a string in its bundle README matched a card in the official labelled set
C_the_fused_numbers_are_descriptive.go_live: if the fused system ships, the go-live record states that its audit number cannot be certified

D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.process_isolation: the contributed model, and the PP-OCRv5 detector if K2 is chosen, run only in a separate worker process. The reading process never imports Paddle code beyond what the frozen adapter already loads. On each card the reading process computes BC-final and v2 first, then passes the in-memory crop input (the band or canonical card it already holds, as bytes) to the worker. This is not a second read of the image: no file is opened by the worker.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.per_card_timeout: max(10 seconds, 10 x the contributed path's per-card p95 in the rehearsal in the read environment), fixed in the manifest
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.failure: an exception, native crash, out-of-memory or timeout in the worker is sealed as contributed_error for that card. It cannot change a BC-final or v2 field, because those are computed in the reading process before the worker is called.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.bounded_round_trip: the per-card timeout covers the whole send-and-receive round trip. A restart of the worker, including its model load and self test, runs under the same timeout.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.abandon_after_three: after 3 consecutive worker failures (card failures or failed restarts), the worker is abandoned for the rest of the read and every remaining card is sealed as contributed_error without calling it. Every card costs at most one round trip plus one restart, each capped at the per-card timeout T, so the contributed path adds at most 2 x 377 x T; abandoning the worker can only lower that.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.contributed_error_downstream: a contributed_error counts as 'not 14 digits' in fusion (R1 and R2 then give BC-final's reading) and in routing. The count of cards with contributed_error is reported beside every fused quantity.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.bc_final_raw_score_for_R2: only if R2 is selected: BC-final's raw score (minimum per-slot softmax maximum) is obtained in the reading process by a second call to runtime.predict_bcfinal on result.band, after BC-final's fields are set; the shadow module is not edited. The call never raises into the loop: on an exception, an argmax that differs from the sealed BC-final reading, or an empty BC-final reading, the card is sealed with bc_raw_score_unavailable and its R2 comparison falls to BC-final's reading, as R1 would give. The flagged count is reported beside the fused quantities. If R2 is selected, the three-way parity rehearsal includes this call and must show no flag and no change to any BC-final or v2 field.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.nothing_fused_raises_into_the_loop: every fused-system step that runs in the reading process (the worker round trip, the raw-score call, fusion, sealing of fused fields) is wrapped so that it cannot raise into the loop; a failure is sealed as a per-card flag and falls back to BC-final's reading
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.load: the worker is started, loads the contributed model and passes its self test among the pre-read refusals, before any audit:card ledger event (7c R2 order); a failure there blocks without a trace
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.if_the_self_test_fails_at_the_read: stop and ask the owner, who chooses: fix it and retry (no trace was left), or read BC-final alone as frozen, which gives up the fused audit numbers for good
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.parity: in the read environment, before the manifest is regenerated, the rehearsal runs on the development photos three ways: without the contributed path, with it, and with it plus an injected worker exception and an injected worker kill. The BC-final and v2 sealed fields are compared field by field and must be identical across all three.
D_the_contributed_model_cannot_change_bc.midnight: the read starts only if the larger of (a) twice the rehearsal estimate that includes the contributed path, in the read environment, and (b) BC-final's rehearsal time plus 2 x 377 x T ends before 23:30 local time (supersedes execution.midnight for a read that seals the fused system)

E_the_missing_card.rule: D-005 and D-007: the one audit card with no image is an admission failure. It is in the admission-failure rate, exact_card_accuracy_all and criterion 4 (both-wrong, concordant); it is not in criterion 1, which counts only captures that produced a band
E_the_missing_card.pin: the sha256 of its card_id, computed by the owner with `python scripts/phase4_audit.py missing-pin` (existence check only; no ledger event, no read marker), is recorded as allowed_missing_card_id_sha256 in a later amendment. Until then any missing image blocks the read (7b B2)

F_where_the_read_runs.rule: the read runs where Paddle loads. On 2026-09-27 the owner's Windows machine blocked it at model load, so the read environment is expected to be Linux. That design (paths, the override, the ledger, the guard, no copy of audit images, one invocation) is brought to the owner before any read code changes.

amendment_7h.status: ADOPTED by the owner (the owner, project owner) in chat on 2026-09-27. Decision log D-013, D-014. Not a proposal.
amendment_7h.committed_before: the manifest is regenerated and before any audit image is opened or any audit label is read. The audit has not been opened.
amendment_7h.append_only: the sections above are not edited; where this block contradicts them, it governs, and it names what it supersedes
amendment_7h.the_integration_stopped: D-013: INTEGRATION_NOT_WORTH_IT. As 7g A declared for that case, nothing fused is sealed. 7g A (fused sealing), C and D (the worker) do not apply. wsl_adaptations_committed_before_the_man.git: the worktree's .git file points at a Windows path that Linux git cannot follow, so scripts/phase2m_h.py git() names the git directory explicitly under Linux. It still fails closed on any git error.
wsl_adaptations_committed_before_the_man.untracked_check: under WSL, .venv, data and third_party are symlinks into OCR_ID_working, which the directory-only ignore patterns do not match. .gitignore adds root-anchored entries so the no-untracked-files refusal sees the same clean tree on both systems.
wsl_adaptations_committed_before_the_man.self_test_fonts: the sealed v2 config names the self-test fonts C:/Windows/Fonts/*.ttf. During model load only, PIL gets /mnt/c/Windows/Fonts/*.ttf (phase4_audit.windows_font_paths); a no-op on Windows. The self-tests must still reproduce their sealed hashes.
wsl_adaptations_committed_before_the_man.detector_revision_check: the vendored DocCornerNet checks its pinned git revision. Git's ownership check on that one repository is satisfied by a process-scope safe.directory (GIT_CONFIG_COUNT) in the owner's command. No global setting changes.
wsl_adaptations_committed_before_the_man.no_copy: audit images are read in place through /mnt/c (data is a link into OCR_ID_working/data). Nothing is copied, and the ledger is this worktree's artifacts/governance/override_ledger.json.

amendment_7h.preflight: python scripts/phase4_audit.py preflight runs every refusal that comes before the ledger, plus the model load and self-tests, without the authorisations. It opens no audit image, reads no label and writes nothing. It must print all_pass true in the read environment before the read starts.
amendment_7h.authorisations: the owner sets OCRID_GOVERNANCE_OVERRIDE=OPEN-377-AUDIT-<date> and PHASE2M_H_OPEN_THE_AUDIT in her own WSL terminal. The date is WSL's local date (date +%F), which is what Python's date.today() compares against in that shell. The Claude Code session never sets either.
amendment_7h.midnight: the WSL rehearsal measured 1.172 s per image and an 8.3 s bundle load, so 377 cards take about 450 s. Twice that is about 15 minutes, so the read starts before 23:15 local time.
amendment_7h.pin: the missing card's sha256 (7g E) is recorded by the next amendment, after the owner runs missing-pin. Until then, the missing-image refusal blocks the read.

amendment_7i.status: the owner ran `python scripts/phase4_audit.py missing-pin` in her own WSL terminal on 2026-09-27, under both authorisations, and pasted its output in chat (D-005, D-007, 7g E)
amendment_7i.committed_before: the manifest is regenerated and before any audit image is opened or any audit label is read. missing-pin checks file existence only: it opens no image, reads no label and writes no ledger event.
amendment_7i.rule: refuse_if_images_missing allows exactly this card to have no image. Any other missing image still blocks the read before the ledger (7b B2). The pinned card goes through the read, where the adapter returns CORRUPT_IMAGE, so it is an admission failure (D-005, D-007): in the admission-failure rate, exact_card_accuracy_all and criterion 4 (both-wrong, concordant), and not in criterion 1.
